title: Sparkly magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lens' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d9f7ff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#7fd4ef' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3f9ec4' stop-opacity='0.45'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='61' y='60' width='13' height='30' rx='6' transform='rotate(-45 67 75)' fill='#d9a05b'/>
  <rect x='64' y='62' width='5' height='26' rx='2.5' transform='rotate(-45 67 75)' fill='#f6cf94'/>
  <!-- rim -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='27' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='24' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <!-- lens -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='21' fill='url(#lens)'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='31' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-30 34 31)'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff275'>
    <path d='M18 14 l2 6 l6 2 l-6 2 l-2 6 l-2 -6 l-6 -2 l6 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M86 26 l1.5 5 l5 1.5 l-5 1.5 l-1.5 5 l-1.5 -5 l-5 -1.5 l5 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M78 78 l1.5 5 l5 1.5 l-5 1.5 l-1.5 5 l-1.5 -5 l-5 -1.5 l5 -1.5 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7fe7ff'>
    <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='48' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='40' r='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
